ws.dept_not_staffed: Your department is marked as not staffed for live response. The public sees this truthfully. An administrator can change it under Availability once people are in place.
ws.must_change_password: You are using a temporary password.
ws.no_cases_text: Cases appear here when they are routed to your department or assigned to you.

case.restricted_text: You can see this case exists and its state, but not its content. Content is visible to assigned staff and to the department handling triage. Administrators may use break-glass access with a written reason, which is logged and reviewed.
case.status_help: Only transitions allowed from the current status are listed.
case.error_transition: That status change is not allowed from the current status.
case.error_reason: Give a reason of at least 10 characters.
case.note_help: Never paste identity details into notes; use the identity panel instead.
case.update_help: Shown on the tracking page. No names, numbers or addresses: the text is scanned and refused if it contains identifiers.
case.update_saved: Message posted to the tracking page.
case.update_has_identifiers: The message seems to contain contact details or identifiers. Remove them and try again.
case.break_glass_text: Reads the narrative and notes once, with your reason recorded. Use only for governance reasons such as a complaint about case handling. Identity is NOT included; use the identity panel separately if essential.
case.break_glass_logged: This emergency read has been logged for review by another administrator.
case.break_glass_no_identity: Reporter identity and legal-privileged notes are not shown in break-glass view.

severity.none_yet: No assessment yet. A human must assess before the case moves on.
severity.level1: Level 1 — Routine information or non-urgent concern
severity.level1_desc: Information request or a concern with no indication of ongoing harm.
severity.level2: Level 2 — Elevated concern requiring timely review
severity.level2_desc: Harm or risk that needs action within days.
severity.level3_desc: Credible threats, stalking, coercive blackmail or ongoing abuse.
severity.level4: Level 4 — Critical immediate danger or urgent child-safety concern
severity.level4_desc: Immediate danger to a person or an urgent child-protection concern. Act today.
severity.assess_help: Describes urgency and potential harm, never guilt. Lack of evidence does not mean low risk.
severity.reasoning_help: At least 20 characters. Say what you weighed and why.
severity.override_help: Tick when you disagree with an earlier level; both stay on record.
severity.error_reasoning: Reasoning must be at least 20 characters.

access.identity_help: Shown once, in this response only. Who, when, which case and why are logged and visible to administrators.
access.logged_text: Your name, the time, this case and your reason are now on the audit trail.
access.identity_rules: Do not copy these details into notes, messages or external systems. Contact only in the way the reporter chose. Never contact the people listed under 'do not contact'.
access.identity_none: No identity is stored for this case (anonymous report, or the identity was purged under the retention policy).

identity.error_denied: You are not allowed to unlock this identity.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.file_help: Allowed: JPG, PNG, WebP, PDF, MP3, M4A, MP4, TXT. Content is checked against the file type.
evidence.error_denied: You are not allowed to download this file.

custody.title: Chain of custody
custody.hash_mismatch: HASH MISMATCH: the file does not match its original fingerprint.

referral.title: Referrals
referral.consent_help: Required before anything is sent to a third party. Record how consent was given in the notes.
referral.confirmation_help: Required to mark as confirmed: a reference number, letter or named contact.
referral.error_confirmation: A confirmation reference is required to mark a referral as confirmed.

outcome.title: Outcomes
outcome.help: Record only what you can document. 'Unknown' is an honest outcome.
outcome.finding_help: Describes the official position, not our opinion. A report is an allegation until an authority says otherwise.
outcome.confirmation_help: Required for submitted complaints, platform actions and official outcomes.
outcome.error_description: Describe the outcome in at least 10 characters.
outcome.error_confirmation: This outcome type requires a confirmation reference.
outcome.error_self_verify: You cannot verify an outcome you recorded yourself.

legal.title: Legal intake
legal.qualified_help: Name of the qualified lawyer who reviewed. Required before any legal determination is recorded.

moderation.help: Threats, doxxing, spam, coordinated harassment, prohibited material and suspected fabrication. Decisions are logged and can be appealed.
moderation.flag_help: Any staff member can flag content. Moderators decide.
moderation.hold_case: Put the case on moderation hold
moderation.error_same_moderator: An appeal must be decided by a different moderator.
moderation.case_id_note: find the case by its internal ID in the list.

publication.pipeline_help: Every piece moves left to right. Nothing can be published until every gate is green.
publication.new_help: Drafts are private. Writing from a case requires that the reporter consented to redacted publication.
publication.label: Public label
publication.label_help: What readers are told this is. 'Reported allegation' is the default for case stories.
publication.headline: Headline (English)
publication.body_help: Write it already de-identified. The redaction gate will refuse emails, phone numbers, NID-like numbers, URLs and handles.
publication.legal_required_help: Always on for stories and investigations.
publication.case_reference_help: Optional. You must be able to read the case.
publication.saved: Draft saved. Later gates were reset.
publication.edit_warning: Editing after a gate resets redaction, editorial and legal sign-off.
publication.consent_safety_help: Confirm the reporter's consent is on file and that publishing cannot foreseeably endanger anyone. Child-safety cases cannot pass as stories.
publication.source_help: Assess sources and evidence. You must not be the drafter. Confirm conflicts of interest were checked and a right of response was offered.
publication.conflict_checked: Conflict of interest checked for everyone involved
publication.right_of_response: Right of response offered to the person or institution concerned
publication.ror_help: Required for anything other than awareness material.
publication.editorial_help: Second-person check of the whole piece: accuracy, labelling, tone, redaction. The drafter cannot approve.
publication.publish_help: A final identifier scan runs on publish.
publication.redaction_failed: Redaction gate failed: identifiers found or checklist incomplete. See findings.
publication.draft_from_case: Draft a publication from this case
publication.public_footer: Help Lagbe? publishes only after consent, safety review, source assessment, redaction, editorial review and, where needed, legal review. Reported allegations are not findings of guilt.
publication.error_headline: Headline must be at least 10 characters.
publication.error_no_consent: The reporter has not consented to publication.
publication.error_locked: Published or withdrawn pieces cannot be edited; add a correction instead.
publication.error_stage: This action is not available at the current stage.
publication.error_body: The text must be at least 50 characters.
publication.error_notes: Notes must be at least 10 characters.
publication.error_permission: You do not have permission for this step.
publication.error_child_safety: Child-safety cases are never published as stories.
publication.error_two_person: A second person must do this step; the drafter cannot review their own work.
publication.error_right_of_response: A right of response must be offered before approval.
publication.error_identifiers: Identifiers were found in the text. Redact and try again.

pub_label_help.reported_allegation: What people have told us. It has not been established by any authority and does not mean anyone is guilty.
pub_label_help.corroborated_finding: Supported by more than one independent source or document reviewed by our editorial team. Still not a legal finding.
pub_label_help.official_statement: A statement from an authority or institution, reproduced as given.
pub_label_help.court_established_outcome: An outcome recorded by a court.
pub_label_help.awareness_material: Educational material; not about a specific case.

redaction.help: Confirm each item. The text is also scanned automatically; any finding blocks this gate.
redaction.no_names: No names of reporters, victims, witnesses or children
redaction.no_contacts: No phone numbers, emails or handles
redaction.no_child_identifiers: Nothing that could identify a child

ror.title: Right of response
ror.party_help: Describe the party without naming private individuals.
ror.publish: Publish the response with the piece
ror.offered_note: The party concerned was offered a right of response.

social.title: Social media drafts
social.help: Drafts are prepared here, approved by a second person, exported and posted manually. Nothing is posted automatically. A draft is marked as posted only when a person enters the live URL.
social.export_help: Copy the text into the channel yourself. Then return and confirm with the live URL.
social.export_note: This page does not post anything.
social.error_not_published: Only published pieces can have social drafts.
social.error_confirm: Give the https:// address of the live post.

admin.cannot_change_self: You cannot change your own role or deactivate yourself.
admin.mfa_reset_done: Two-step verification reset. The person will enrol again at next sign-in.
admin.create_staff_help: The person must change the temporary password and enrol in two-step verification at first sign-in.
admin.availability_help: What the public is told about each workspace. A department can only be marked staffed if at least one active account belongs to it.
admin.is_staffed_help: Shown on the public site. Live chat additionally requires an agent to be present.
admin.cannot_mark_staffed: A department with no active staff cannot be marked as staffed.
admin.contact_verified: Contact verified and now visible to the public.
admin.mfa_required: Require two-step verification for all staff
admin.mfa_required_help: Turning this off is logged. Keep it on.
admin.public_registration_help: Reporter accounts are optional; turning this off hides the registration page.
admin.announcement_help: Shown at the top of the home page. Leave empty for none.
admin.policy_defaults_help: Changed through environment variables, not here.

audit.help: Append-only. Sensitive events (identity unlocks, evidence downloads, break-glass, supervisor reads, exports) are marked.
audit.export_help: The export itself is logged with your reason. It contains no narratives or identities.

perm.help: Permissions are fixed in code per role. Case content is additionally need-to-know: assignment or own-department triage is required to read a narrative.
perm.need_to_know: Administrators manage people and policy; they do not read narratives, identities or support chats except through logged break-glass access.

retention.help: Cases appear here {days} days after they were resolved or closed. Review each one: purge the stored identity when it is no longer needed. Case narratives are kept for accountability; purges are logged.
retention.none_due: Nothing is due for retention review.
